Context: 2. Seniority of Officers Under Suspension or facing Enquiries

- 2.2. Enquiries Pending.If an officer has been recommended for promotion by a Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) despite the  
imposition of a minor penalty, the officer will be promoted after the expiry of the penalty based on the DPC's recommendation, and their seniority will be fixed according to their position in the panel.
